title: voyager 2
body:
last night i dreamed you could fly.
rose so high, defied
the cold separation of distant molecules
straining to pull you into nebula matter.
i dreamed you saw me for more than the dot
of light in the firefly blanket on the dark side
of the earth so i turned off my night light
and prayed you'd notice the closing of two
eyes in sixteen billion.

watch over me so im not forgotten.
watch over me so i will not fall silently
in the forest of pylons and lampposts that
pin my existence to the ground beneath my
feet. for if i am to die tomorrow, i want you to
hear the final broadcast i send to you,
